about: Recorded HTTP traffic from each Go provider client against an httptest server (base URL replaced by the test server; {BASE_URL} in error strings). Retry policy in these runs: base 1 ms, max 2 ms, 3 attempts. headers are exactly what Go sent; platform-dependent header values: Content-Length, User-Agent, X-Goog-Api-Client, X-Stainless-Arch, X-Stainless-Os, X-Stainless-Runtime-Version. Body strings are the exact bytes sent (Google's body ends with a newline). completion_response uses Go field names Text/TokensIn/TokensOut. error_string is err.Error() and is what the runner stores in runs.error.

context_timeout_mid_retry.setup: server always 429; retry policy base 500 ms, max 1 s; caller context timeout 100 ms
